title: OCCURRENCE OF A CYBER SECURITY ECO-SYSTEM: A NATURE ORIENTED PROJECT AND EVALUATION OF AN INDIRECT SOCIAL EXPERIMENT
reasoning: The paper's central finding is the analysis of an 'indirect social experiment' that spontaneously arose during a cybersecurity education project. This experiment centrally involved the evaluation of participants' ethical behavior. The paper details how student teams adopted roles of malicious actors ('cyber pirates') using tricking and social engineering, while other teams acted as 'ethical hackers'. The observation and analysis of these ethical choices and behaviors form a core component of the study, going beyond a mere 'ethical considerations' section.
